title: RAW_UNREVIEWED: one same-result relation scopes two derivations in two complete passages
summary: A shared semantic inventory would include a relation that marks two independently stated routes as co-referring to one result in each of two complete passages. This tests route equivalence and scope, not two inputs converging or a repeated count.

target_passages: P1: f82r.1-f82r.9, complete exposed P28 reading N2
P2: f82r.11-f82r.19, complete exposed P28 reading N2
design.candidate_inventory: A shared equivalence/check relation whose scope contains two route clauses and one resulting whole. No English word, numeric token, or specific candidate occurrence is promoted.
design.source_owned_constraint: The complete Fibonacci account both narrates successive births and explains the margin by adding consecutive totals, explicitly 1+2 and 144+233=377; the route and the aggregate result are constrained to agree. Cassius Dio XXXVII.18-19 gives two accounts of the next planetary ruler: advancing through 24 hourly positions and skipping two members of the seven-name order. The two accounts are required to reach the same next ruler.
design.target_fields_required: Each complete target passage would need two distinguishable route/derivation fields, a scope boundary for the relation, and one result field that both routes address. Which written forms carry those fields is unknown and must be established before any semantic reading.
design.contrast: A single co-reference/equivalence relation shared across P1 and P2 versus independent local checks, unrelated lists, or two paths that merely end near the same form.
design.prediction: Under global renaming of the route participants, the same relation scope and one-result binding survive in both complete passages. Arbitrary semantic reassignment breaks at least one route-to-result binding or requires a different relation for each passage.
design.falsifier: A complete P1/P2 fit cannot identify two route clauses and one common result without free occurrence-specific meanings; or the proposed relation permits unequal route results, a reset list, or a destination-only convergence model.
closest_closed_predecessors: IDEA000408: two source paths converge on one downstream destination; this proposal requires two derivations of the same result, not two inputs merging
IDEA000379: coupled hourly/daily ruler relation, which supplies the Cassius source consequence but is a single-P2 content hypothesis
GDT951: fixed zodiac tuple renderer, contradicted by complete label-domain incompatibility
design.why_distinct: The discriminator is scope over co-referring derivations and their equality of result. It is not a count, a simple Rosetta mapping, a fixed tuple renderer, a split/merge identity claim, or IDEA000406's order-sensitive intermediate state.
design.strongest_likely_failure: Neither complete exposed target passage may contain two independently recoverable derivations. If route multiplicity and result fields are not written, equivalence cannot be separated from editorial repetition or a flat list.
design.meaning_binding_debt: No target word meaning or participant role is known. The proposal remains RAW_UNREVIEWED and cannot license a source choice, decoder, or semantic confirmation.
design.source_limits: Fibonacci source limits and Cassius Dio witness limits are the same as in the existing AGE_COHORT_POPULATION_SUPPLY.md and raw_transport_weaving_hours_context_20260920.md records; no new target or reserve material was opened.
